name: Admin Diagnostic Filters
description: Filter diagnostics using saved tabs with localStorage persistence and URL sync (?tab=<tabId>). Filter dimensions: statuses (multi-select), investmentMin/Max, createdAfter/Before. Tab bar supports add/rename/delete (max 12 tabs).
knownGaps: Own-tag tests added 2026-07-23 (round 6): status dimension filtering, Limpiar todo reset and diagnosticTab URL sync, inside admin-diagnostic-advanced-filters.spec.js.
